text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… The air is crisp and refreshing…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's impressive you show so much drive this early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You plan to go for a run, I assume? Would you mind if I came along?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Of course not. But why are you up this early?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Surely you remember the events of last winter? A certain someone took off running in the morning, never to return.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh… Hehe, I think I remember.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This year won't be a repeat of the last. I plan to monitor you the whole way through.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …I always appreciate it, Air Groove. So, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… She never knows how to hold back… Don't go sprinting off!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Perhaps it's the clear winter air, but Air Groove's footsteps sound…)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Perhaps it's the calm of early morning, but Suzuka's breathing sounds…)

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Closer than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We've done enough running. It's time to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Already? That flew by so fast…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly… If I hadn't spoken up, I fear you would've run to the corners of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe… But if that happened, I know you would come running after me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just like in our races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hah. Either way, I'm not letting you escape. So stay on your toes.
